headline: Unplanned run exceeded the rest prescription; no more running today
summary: The early-morning recommendation was a planned rest day. Garmin now records a 6.77 km run in 40m 32s at 5:59/km, average HR 154, maximum HR 179, training load 112, and aerobic effect 3.3. Because running was explicitly excluded, today's adherence verdict is did_not_follow. The run also produced materially more measured cardiovascular and training strain than yesterday at essentially the same pace. Do no more running today and do not automatically add tomorrow's planned 6 km.

recovery.label: Sleep
recovery.context: 13 minutes above Garmin's 8h 20m estimated need. Sleep stages were rated excellent; average sleep stress was 20.

recovery.label: Sleeping HR
recovery.context: 0.4 bpm above the prior 7-night average (63.6) and 0.2 bpm below the prior 14-night average (64.2).

recovery.label: Resting HR
recovery.context: 3 bpm above Garmin's seven-day average of 58 bpm.

recovery.label: HRV
recovery.context: 2 ms below Garmin's 43 ms weekly average; Garmin still classifies HRV as balanced and its readiness contribution as very good.

recovery.label: Stress
recovery.context: Both are incomplete Garmin day-to-date measures. Average sleep stress was 20.

recovery.label: Body Battery
recovery.context: Garmin recorded a 64-point change across sleep and a 25-point daytime drain by the post-run refresh.

recovery.label: Training Readiness
recovery.context: Readiness changed from Prime at 6:17 am to Moderate at 12:48 pm. Recovery time rose from 2h 54m to 25h 23m.

recovery.label: Recent load
recovery.context: The activity added training load 112. Garmin still classifies the acute/chronic ratio as low.

yesterday.title: Easy-run prescription followed; no extra session
yesterday.summary: The preceding report recorded the planned easy run as complete and instructed no further running on 9 September. Garmin shows that single 5.25 km run and no additional workout.
yesterday.prescribed: Complete approximately 5 km easy within a 35-minute cap, then do no further running; take 10 September as the planned rest day.
yesterday.completed: One run: 5.25 km in 31m 22s at 5:59/km, average HR 137, maximum HR 155, training load 55, aerobic effect 2.6, anaerobic effect 0, and 67 m elevation gain.
yesterday.adherence_assessment: The easy run stayed below the duration cap and was already assessed as compliant. Garmin recorded no second run or other workout after it.
adherence_evidence: Garmin lists one activity with a 9 September Sydney start time and no other workout that day.
The session was 0.25 km above the nominal distance but remained under 35 minutes, with no recorded time in HR zones 4–5.
Garmin labelled the training effect aerobic base.
adherence_caveats: Garmin cannot verify perceived effort, pain, illness, terrain intent, or unrecorded activity.

environment.observed_temperature_range: 17–23°C recorded by the Garmin device during the run.
environment.humidity_dew_point_context: A reliable route-time Sydney humidity and dew-point estimate was not available, so none was used.
environment.heat_impact_interpretation: The device temperature range alone does not establish meaningful heat strain. No adherence penalty or heart-rate inference was made from weather.
environment.limitations: Garmin temperature is a device measurement and may be affected by body heat and local exposure; it is not the same as an official city observation.

recommendation.title: No more running today
details: Morning recommendation, retained for comparison: planned rest day—no running, with only optional easy walking or gentle mobility.
Completed instead: 6.77 km in 40m 32s at 5:59/km, average HR 154, maximum HR 179, training load 112, aerobic effect 3.3, and anaerobic effect 0.3.
Stop there today. Do not add a second run, strides, hills, tempo, or extra distance.
Do not automatically complete tomorrow's previously planned 6 km. Reassess the 11 September overnight record; default to rest if recovery is not clearly reassuring.
recommendation.alternative: Complete rest for the remainder of today, with normal hydration and food. Only gentle mobility if it feels comfortable.
recommendation.reduce_or_stop: Stop optional activity for pain, illness, dizziness, altered gait, unusual fatigue, chest symptoms, or other concerning symptoms. Symptoms and medical advice override Garmin scores.

signals.label: Morning prescription versus actual
signals.interpretation: This is a direct, measurable departure from the morning plan, so today's adherence verdict is did_not_follow.

signals.label: Higher measured strain at the same pace
signals.interpretation: Garmin measured average HR 17 bpm higher than yesterday at essentially identical pace. The device recorded 18–26°C, so warmth is plausible context, but it does not by itself establish the cause.

signals.label: Post-run recovery cost
signals.interpretation: The run more than doubled yesterday's training load of 55 and materially increased recovery time, supporting no further running today and a fresh decision tomorrow.

caveats: Garmin sleep, heart-rate, HRV, stress, Body Battery, readiness, and load measures are wearable-derived; use trends alongside how you feel.
Garmin's heart-rate trace may differ from another wrist device or a chest strap; no Apple Watch data was published or used in this assessment.
The 18–26°C range is a Garmin device measurement and may be affected by body heat and local exposure. No reliable city-level route-time humidity or dew-point estimate was used.
The assessment does not infer perceived effort, pain, illness, terrain intent, or why the run was completed.

run_assessments.title: 10 September run
run_assessments.summary: Morning plan: rest. Completed: 6.77 km in 40m 32s at 5:59/km, average HR 154, maximum HR 179, training load 112, aerobic effect 3.3, and anaerobic effect 0.3.
run_assessments.assessment: The run did not follow today's explicit rest prescription. Garmin labelled it aerobic base, but its measured strain was materially above yesterday's run at the same pace: average HR was 17 bpm higher, load rose from 55 to 112, and 16m 36s was recorded in HR zones 4–5. Garmin recorded 18–26°C, which may have contributed to the higher heart rate; without route-level weather or a reference-quality HR sensor, it is not possible to assign the difference to heat, physiology, or sensor error.
run_assessments.interpretation: The measurable session did not follow the rest prescription. No further running today; reassess tomorrow rather than automatically adding the planned 6 km.

signals.label: Plan comparison
signals.interpretation: Running was explicitly excluded by the morning prescription.

signals.label: Cardiovascular measure
signals.interpretation: Garmin recorded 24m 10s in zone 3 and 16m 36s in zones 4–5.

signals.label: Training effect
signals.interpretation: Garmin classified the session as aerobic base, but it imposed more than twice yesterday's training load.
